# Dripcel

Dripcel is a platform for automated SMS and Email marketing, campaign compliance, and data-driven lead generation.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/dripcel/.

## Actions

- **Add tags to a contact**: Add tags to a contact.
- **Delete Contact**: Delete a contact by their cell number.
- **Dripcel Post Compliance Send** (read-only): Check a list of cell numbers against campaign targeting criteria.
- **Get current credit balance** (read-only): Get current credit balance.
- **Get Deliveries** (read-only): Retrieve a list of deliveries.
- **Get Dripcel Campaigns** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all campaigns.
- **Get email templates** (read-only): List all available email templates.
- **Get sales** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all sales.
- **Search replies based on filters** (read-only): Search replies based on filters.
- **Send SMS**: Send a single sms to a contact.
